blocks.html: The input to the transfer order to guest workflow.

types.name: order_id
types.description: The ID of the order to transfer.

types.name: email
types.description:
The email of the guest customer to transfer the order to.
If no customer exists with this email, a guest customer is created.

types.name: logged_in_user
types.description: The ID of the logged in user requesting the transfer.

types.name: internal_note
types.description: A note viewed by admin users only.
